headline: Maintaining Growth Momentum Amid Year-End Pressure
summary: Vietnam's economy continued positive growth in the first eight months of the year, with investment, consumption and budget revenue posting encouraging results. Inflation, the trade deficit and disbursement progress remain pressures.
why: Growth, inflation and trade balances drive central bank policy and foreign investor appetite for Vietnamese assets.
